item.title: Pantograph 1.2.2
item.description:
New

  • Print (⌘P). File › Print… prints the PDF or photo you're looking at. PDFs print as they are now, with any text boxes, signatures and other markup, even before you save; each page fits the paper. Photos print as large as the paper allows, turned to match their shape, with your edits. It's in the right-click menu too.

If you have Pantograph 1.1.3 or later, it will offer this update by itself (1.1.7 and later install it quietly when you quit). Otherwise, download Pantograph-1.2.2.dmg, open it and drag Pantograph to Applications. Requires macOS 13 or later; runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized by Apple.
